description: Hello! I'm Mubarak, an AI student at FAST-NUCES Karachi. Building team "Tensor Hawks" for the Space Mission Design Game at NASA Space Apps. Skills: C, Python, Unity, SQL. Looking for Unity devs, Python physics devs, API devs, and UI/UX designers to build simulation features and interactive graphics.
summary: Tensor Hawks Space Mission Design Game is an interactive 3D interplanetary space mission simulator built with Unity 3D and backed by a Python FastAPI physics engine. The game challenges players to design, budget, and launch space missions across the Solar System (Mars, Jupiter, Saturn) using realistic launch vehicles (SpaceX Falcon 9, SLS, Tensor Rocket). By solving real-world engineering constraints via Tsiolkovsky’s Rocket Equation, mass ratios, and financial capital limits, players receive real-time telemetry feedback, dynamic 3D orbital trajectories, and telemetry analysis of their mission's success or failure.
details:
. Project Overview & Inspiration

The Space Mission Design Game bridges orbital mechanics and interactive gameplay. Inspired by NASA’s Eyes on the Solar System visual aesthetic and open space telemetry data, our project translates complex aerospace engineering principles—such as Delta-V budgets, specific impulse ($I_{sp}$), and mass ratios—into an intuitive 3D simulation experience.

2. Core Architecture & System Features

  • Screen 1: Main Menu & Launchpad Setup — Features a space aesthetic with main navigation, settings controls, and initial audio setup.
  • Screen 2: Destination Selection — Players choose target celestial bodies (Mars, Jupiter, Saturn), each requiring distinct$\Delta v$thresholds (5,700 m/s to 10,200 m/s) and light-time telemetry latency constraints.
  • Screen 3: Rocket Hangar Setup & Payload Customization — Players select launch vehicles (SpaceX Falcon 9, Space Launch System, or Tensor Rocket) and adjust fuel mass, payload mass, mission budget limits, and scientific instrument packages.
  • FastAPI Microservice Physics Validation — When launch is initiated, Unity dispatches an HTTP POST JSON request to a Python FastAPI backend that calculates total wet/dry mass ratios, provided$\Delta v$, power output ($AU$), and financial capital constraints.
  • Screen 4: 3D Orbit Viewport & Cubic Bezier Trajectories — Upon validation, Unity renders a 3-phase smooth transit trajectory from Low Earth Orbit to target destination insertion using velocity-matched circular orbits and particle engine thrusters.
  • Screen 5: Telemetry Drawer & Failure Safety Gate — If parameters pass, the camera locks into Planet Overview mode and opens the Telemetry Drawer upon arrival. If the mission fails (e.g., insufficient fuel or exceeded budget), the simulator keeps the player in the Hangar with diagnostic telemetry logs explaining the failure so they can adjust sliders and retry.

3. Technology Stack

  • Front-End / Visualization: Unity 2022 LTS / Unity 6 (C#), TextMeshPro, Universal Render Pipeline (URP).
  • Back-End / Physics Engine: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic, NumPy.
  • Communication: RESTful API (UnityWebRequest$\leftrightarrow$JSON payloads over HTTP).
  • Target Platforms: Windows Standalone .exe & WebGL
